Belleek
Porcelain Desk Pen Stand with Pen
Circa 1990s, Gilt Accents and Nautical Motif
Crafted by Belleek Pottery in County Fermanagh, Ireland, this glazed porcelain desk stand showcases the maker's renowned craftsmanship in fine ceramic wares. The oval base features low-relief nautical motifs including an embossed scallop shell, starfish, and textured rope border, highlighted by an interior gold-gilt accent line. Complete with an adjustable gold-tone ball-and-socket swivel mount and matching desk pen, it represents both functional executive utility and classic decorative styling.
Glazed ivory porcelain base with detailed embossed seashell, starfish, and rope motifs
Gilded accent line framing the inner tray recess with matching gold-tone swivel pen cup
Fitted green protective felt underside bearing gold foil Belleek crest; blue trademark on rim
Base measures approximately 9" long by 5" wide
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The porcelain base is free of chips, cracks, or crazing, and the gilded trim remains bright. The green felt underside and maker marks are fully intact. The gold-tone desk pen rests securely in the swivel socket with bright finish, showing clear tape wrapped around the center barrel. Ink cartridge functionality is not guaranteed.
Only includes what is shown in pictures, any accessories or items not shown but described cannot be guaranteed to be included with the lot.
